multiSelectable.description:
Whether to allow the user to select multiple shapes at once (nodes and edges).
If true, multi select gesture is "Meta" for MacOs, "Control" for other systems. A user can also
select multi via drag box selection with "Shift" key.

isDeleteEnabled.description:
Whether to allow the user to delete nodes.
If true, the default key is "Backspace"

layout.description:
The layout algorithm to apply to the diagram.
If null, assumes consumer is going to have a custom implementation via setting the `position`
field on the {@link NodeDiagramNode}.

onlyRenderVisibleElements.description:
Whether to enable the library's optimization to only render elements in the current viewport.
See {@link https://reactflow.dev/api-reference/react-flow#only-render-visible-elements}

minZoomLevel.description:
Defines the minimum zoom level for the diagram.
For example, 0.05 will allow the user to zoom out until 5% of original height.

maxZoomLevel.description:
Defines the maximum zoom level for the diagram.
For example, 3 will allow the user to zoom in until 300% of original height.

minimap.description: Defines minimap configuration options such as dimensions

title:
Configurations for the diagram that are not expected to change over the course of the lifetime
of the component.
name: NodeDiagram.ConfigurationOptions
